title: Identify the Equations
text: We have the y-axis, so $$x=0$$, $$x=3$$, $$f(x)=1+2x$$, and the line parallel to this, so with the same slope and passing through $$(2,7)$$. We can solve for $$b$$ in y-intercept form: $$7=2\times2+b$$, and get our final equation.

title: Length and Width
text: The lengths and widths are the absolute values of the difference between our equations.
